notes.text: The supplied notice cites Shabbat 137b for Rav Huna bar Chiyun. That name does not occur in the saved William Davidson digital text of that folio. The citation is retained as an unresolved source question, without asserting a printing error or absence from other editions.
The matching story is at [Shabbat 139b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.139b.8). It names Rav Huna son of Rabbi Chiyun and gives Rav Huna berabbi Chilvon as an alternative.

The printed notice under Chiyun (vol. II, p. 423) does cite 137b. Hyman’s notice under Halvon (vol. I, p. 351) cites 139b and quotes the two names given there, including Rav Huna son of Rabbi Chiyun. The earlier Sefer Yuchasin also associates the two name forms with this episode, using Chalyon for the alternative. This comparison leaves the discrepancy between Hyman’s two citations unexplained.
